title: Optimization panels: compact diffs, SafeApply timeline, and granular rollback UX
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Deliver a compact, developer-friendly set of UI panels in Optimize that surface batching + caching recommendations, show a condensed diff preview, and provide an audit-ready SafeApply timeline with rollback controls. Focus areas: 1) Recommendation tiles that minimize cognitive load while exposing cost delta, confidence, and estimated latency impact. 2) A compact diff view that highlights only the actionable configuration deltas (batch sizes, cache TTLs, quantization profiles) and shows tokenized cost delta sparklines. 3) SafeApply timeline: checkpointed apply events with user annotations, canary windows, and a one-click rollback composer that produces an auditable patch and optional dry-run. Goal: increase apply velocity while reducing mistaken config changes and enabling precise post-apply forensic review.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation tiles render in a single row with collapse/expand behavior and show name, cost delta, confidence score, and 1-click preview
Compact diff view shows only changed keys with before/after snippets, inline rationale, and tokenized cost sparklines
SafeApply timeline records apply events with immutable snapshots, operator notes, and links to the exact commit/PR
Rollback composer can generate a revert patch, run a dry-run, and optionally schedule a canary rollback to a subset of routes
All actions produce audit entries exportable as JSON/CSV and visible in Console audit logs
Performance: loading recommendation list with 200 cards completes < 600ms in Console staging
updates: 2026-02-15: Ticket created after stakeholder workshop (PM, Design, Infra) that prioritized apply safety for Optimize. Initial scope defined.
2026-02-20: Design spike complete — two visual directions (dense 'compact tiles' and spacious 'card stack'). Engineering prefers compact to reduce DOM cost; design to iterate accessibility contrast.
2026-02-27: Eng prototype (ENG-5892) demonstrates compact diff render with lazy hydration; initial perf numbers look promising but KV cache renders cause flicker on mobile.
2026-03-03: Design review — choose compact tiles with progressive disclosure. Add a small ‘why this recommendation’ pill with link to eval results. Accessibility a11y checklist added.
2026-03-07: Product + Security sync — audit export format must include operator identity, request context, and pre/post configuration hash (added to acceptance criteria).

2026-03-10: Blocker discovered: backend snapshot API missing stable snapshot IDs for SafeApply. Dependency added: ENG-5968 to add deterministic snapshot IDs and size quota handling. Milestone moved to 2026-03-28.
Next steps: finalize UI copy, implement snapshot API (ENG-5968), implement rollback composer backend, and add telemetry events for cost-delta confirmation.
Notes from DE: include sample links to PRD, mockups, and a small user study plan to validate comprehension of diffs before rollout.
ux_notes: Tile collapsed state surfaces succinct cost delta, confidence band, and a lightweight indicator for suggested handler (batching/cache/quant). Expanded state shows compact diff with inline test coverage and sample tokens. Diff colors use neutral palette with an emphasis color for high-regret changes. Add a small timeline scrubber to SafeApply so operators can jump to checkpointed snapshots.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: operators misapply aggressive quantization leading to quality regressions. Mitigation: include pre-apply dry-run with QA flag, surface model-quality delta from evals, and add a mandatory canary step for changes above configured thresholds.
customer_notes: Target beta customers: two mid-market customers running latency-sensitive chat apps and one enterprise with private deployment requirements. Collect feedback on compact diff legibility and rollback confidence during the beta window.
qa_plan: E2E tests for timeline creation/replay, unit tests for compact diff transformer, perf tests for tile list rendering at scale, and user acceptance tests with 6 participants to validate understanding of cost vs. quality trade-offs.
release_note_snippet: Optimize Console: New compact Recommendation Panels, concise diff previews, and SafeApply timeline for auditable applies and one-click rollback. Beta: Opt-in in console > Optimize > Recommendations.
implementation_notes: Backend must expose deterministic snapshot IDs and an immutable apply event stream. Frontend will use virtualization for long lists and lazy hydrate expanded diffs. Add telemetry events: rec_preview_open, safeapply_start, safeapply_commit, safeapply_rollback. Coordinate with infra for increased snapshot storage quota during beta.
postmortem_trigger: If >3 rollbacks in production within 14 days for the same recommendation type, trigger an incident review and revert the feature for that account.
